description: Baseline of the keyword-engine question set (eval/keyword-engine.questions.json) on the plugin-docs fixture vault (eval/plugin-docs-vault). Summaries only; regenerate the full report with the command below. The set that measured a real 8,000-page vault named private pages and is not in this repository.

measured.note: The fixture is a snapshot of this plugin's own documentation, so the numbers are reproducible by anyone. It is small: the first ten results are 28% of its pages, so page recall at 10 is 1.0 in every category and cannot tell two engines apart. Reciprocal rank and precision at 3 still move. Measuring an engine change needs a corpus of thousands of pages.
